source: The [skip-cite] marker is the documented power-user escape hatch. When placed at the start of a line (per the round-12 fix), it must exempt the commit even when no other exemption applies.

input.commit_message:
fix: emergency hotfix for production crash

[skip-cite: post-incident; spec citation will be added in follow-up doc PR]

Deployed under SEV1 protocol; reverting tomorrow if root cause is not
identified within 4h.

notes: The fix-type subject is NOT in the exempt-types list (only chore/style/ci/build are). Without the [skip-cite] marker this would fail validation. The marker on its own line MUST exempt. Confirms the post-round-12 ordering: scope/type checked first, then [skip-cite] as the final exempt path.
